events.title: Strait of Hormuz Active War - MOU Expires Monday + New Tanker Strikes
events.summary: Day 169 of Iran-US war. Hormuz empirically closed: 1 vessel transiting (1% pre-war), 0 tankers (0% pre-war). This week: 2 UAE/ADNOC tankers attacked, bulk carrier struck Saturday. US-Iran shipping MOU expires Monday Aug 17. Iran parliament advancing bill to formalize Hormuz control. Qatar-Iran rift over 3 detained pilots. CENTCOM chief visited USS Abraham Lincoln amid morale concerns. Trump claims US controls strait; Iran denies. Southern Omani route = highest risk (16 of 18 projectile strikes since July 6).
new_developments: Iran parliament bill to control Hormuz

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - On Track to Be Deadliest Ever
events.summary: WHO Director-General says outbreak on track to surpass deadliest Ebola outbreak ever. Killing one person every 30 minutes (UN News). 4,665 confirmed cases, 2,184 deaths as of Aug 14. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (existing treatments certified for Zaire species only). 46% fatality rate. Spreading across DRC and Uganda. WHO PHEIC declared.
new_developments: WHO says on track to be deadliest ever

events.title: Yen at 159.37 - 0.63 From Intervention Trigger, BOJ Sept Hike 76-80% Priced
events.summary: Yen closed Friday at 159.37, only 0.63 yen from level that triggers intervention. Markets assign 76-80% probability to BOJ rate hike in September. Joint US-Japan intervention (Aug 2-3) has fully unraveled - yen back to pre-intervention levels. Takaichi government says rate decisions are BOJ's call but wants 2% inflation achieved. Hedge funds skeptical of further BOJ hikes. Carry trade unwind risk remains elevated.

events.title: China Property Defaults Hit $130B + PBOC $52B Emergency Liquidity Injection
events.summary: Total defaulted debts among Chinese real estate companies now ~$130B. PBOC executed unprecedented mid-month liquidity injection via overnight reverse repos: 348B yuan ($52B). July activity data may steer yuan and Asian FX. PBOC managing fixing pressure on yuan. Deflation war faltering. No explicit emergency rate cuts but unconventional liquidity operations escalating.

events.title: Hedge Fund Treasury Holdings at $2.4T with 100x Leverage - BOE Warns
events.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas: hedge fund US Treasury holdings reached $2.4T end of 2025, up from $600B a decade ago. Funds leveraging 100x for worthwhile returns. BOE's Pill warned central bank backstops risk fuelling leverage and future crises. BOE cited 2022 pension-fund gilt crisis as model for targeted action. FSB under Bailey failed to secure global consensus due to US deregulation focus. Livemint: central banks stuck in rinse-and-repeat cycle of crises.
new_developments: FSB consensus blocked by US deregulation

events.title: Gold Above $4,400 - Miners Catching Up, GDX +18% Monthly
events.summary: Gold cracked $4,400/oz on Aug 11. VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) up 18% monthly, 53% yearly. Spot market closed weekend. Indian 24K gold at Rs15,513/gram. Safe haven demand driven by Hormuz war, Ebola, and central bank buying. CoinCodex forecasts $4,587 avg August, $5,120 September.
new_developments: GDX finally catching up to gold (+18% monthly)

events.title: UK Drought: ~75% of England Declared Drought, 26M+ Under Hosepipe Ban
events.summary: Government declared drought in almost three-quarters of England. 26M+ people under hosepipe bans. Irrigation restrictions imposed on farmers. Government supporting surge pricing for water during droughts. Reform UK blaming mass immigration, promising to end bans and expand reservoirs. Years of underinvestment in water infrastructure cited. Oil: Brent at $82.40 (down from $93 last scan), up 3.52% monthly. Hormuz disruptions persist but OPEC+ additions and Saudi OSP cuts partially offsetting.

events.title: ECB Rate Path Uncertain Amid US Euro Sales for Yen Intervention
events.summary: ECB cut rates 8 times Jun 2024-Jun 2025, then held until June 2026. Reuters previously reported ECB set to deliver final hike. US sold euros (not dollars) for yen rescue, catching ECB off guard. UK CPI at 2.6% (above 2% target), BOE expected to continue tightening. BOE governor Bailey says 80% of cost-of-living crisis causes are global. Next ECB meeting Oct 28-29.
